sampling_notes: 51 qualifying unique still artifacts: nine Tattoodo portfolio/flash works and 42 works across seven separately credited Dazed practitioner galleries. Publisher concentration is substantial; this is not a representative census of tattoo communities. Eighteen uninspected discovery leads are excluded. No video or live interaction was inspected. All media are linked analytical references, not production assets.
